From 42776497cdbc9a665b384a6dcb85f0d4bd927eab Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dudu Lu <phx0fer@gmail.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 23:47:41 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] Bluetooth: l2cap: Add missing chan lock in
 l2cap_ecred_reconf_rsp

l2cap_ecred_reconf_rsp() calls l2cap_chan_del() without holding
l2cap_chan_lock(). Every other l2cap_chan_del() caller in the file
acquires the lock first. A remote BLE device can send a crafted
L2CAP ECRED reconfiguration response to corrupt the channel list
while another thread is iterating it.

Add l2cap_chan_hold() and l2cap_chan_lock() before l2cap_chan_del(),
and l2cap_chan_unlock() and l2cap_chan_put() after, matching the
pattern used in l2cap_ecred_conn_rsp() and l2cap_conn_del().

Fixes: 15f02b910562 ("Bluetooth: L2CAP: Add initial code for Enhanced Credit Based Mode")
Signed-off-by: Dudu Lu <phx0fer@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Luiz Augusto von Dentz <luiz.von.dentz@intel.com>

diff --git a/net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c b/net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c
index 5a4cd530ef33..77dec104a9c3 100644
--- a/net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c
+++ b/net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c
@@ -5473,7 +5473,13 @@ static inline int l2cap_ecred_reconf_rsp(struct l2cap_conn *conn,
 		if (chan->ident != cmd->ident)
 			continue;
 
+		l2cap_chan_hold(chan);
+		l2cap_chan_lock(chan);
+
 		l2cap_chan_del(chan, ECONNRESET);
+
+		l2cap_chan_unlock(chan);
+		l2cap_chan_put(chan);
 	}
 
 	return 0;
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of the Patch

### Modifications per File

- **net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c**: In the function `l2cap_ecred_reconf_rsp`, added calls to `l2cap_chan_hold(chan)` and `l2cap_chan_lock(chan)` before invoking `l2cap_chan_del(chan, ECONNRESET)`, and calls to `l2cap_chan_unlock(chan)` and `l2cap_chan_put(chan)` after it.

### Relationship Between Modifications

The change brings the locking behavior in `l2cap_ecred_reconf_rsp` into alignment with every other caller of `l2cap_chan_del` in the same file. Previously, the function deleted a channel without acquiring the necessary lock, which could allow a concurrent thread to corrupt the channel list (e.g., while iterating it). By adding the hold/lock/unlock/put sequence, the patch prevents this race condition and ensures safe deletion of the channel.
